execution_command: docker run --rm -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 -v <run_dir>:/work -w /work cp2k/cp2k:2024.3 cp2k -i input.executed.inp -o output.out

warning_or_error: Energy is valid, but electronic outputs are incomplete: consistent PDOS/LDOS, Gaussian spectral integral check
last_MO_smearing_warning_interpretation: Persistent occupation of the highest available MO makes the requested electronic spectrum incomplete; a transient early-SCF warning remains reviewable but does not invalidate a later clean converged spectrum.
kpoint_status_warning: Gamma-only bulk reference; the 2x2x2 energy check has not been run
fermi_reference_warning: Raw CP2K Fermi energy uses the calculation's internal reference. Only E-EF spectral shapes or vacuum-aligned slab proxies are compared.
pdos_consistency_errors: no kind-PDOS file is present; a unique MO list cannot be built
cp2k_normalized_histogram_definition: CP2K 2024.3 DOS Density is normalized over all histogram bins; this field is a spectral-shape fraction per eV, not total KS-orbital DOS.

vacuum_plateau_analysis.method: continuous low-density, low-slope xy-planar-average plateau; CP2K V_HARTREE sign inverted and hartree converted to eV
vacuum_plateau_analysis.work_function_scope_warning: Top/bottom values are prototype slab proxies. The polar CdTe(111) model and fixed initial geometry do not establish an absolute work function.
